description: One investment manager SweetValueLab tracks (Berkshire Hathaway, Pershing Square, Bridgewater and about 80 more) from its latest Form 13F filing on SEC EDGAR: the quarter and filing date, the portfolio's size, its 10 largest positions, and its 10 largest moves that quarter in past tense — bought, added, reduced or sold — with the shares before and after. Also when the next 13F is due. A 13F is filed up to 45 days after the quarter ends, so it shows what the manager held then. From public SEC filings, updated as managers file. Not investment advice.

manager.description: The manager, firm or person: "Berkshire Hathaway", "Warren Buffett", "buffett", "Pershing Square". When several match, the answer lists them; ask again with one's `manager` value.

name: get_investor_holdings
